# {{ site.organization_name | default: site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

{{ site.title }} is a blockchain R&D team working on Ethereum and EVM-based
systems: smart contract development, smart contract security audits, Web3
applications, and applied protocol research. The team has been building on
Ethereum since 2016 and operates as {{ site.organization_name }}, registered in
Singapore.

## Services

- Smart contract development for EVM chains
- Smart contract code audits
- Web3 applications, APIs and server-side services
- Hardware debug and firmware development (nRF52, CH549)
- Technical concept and task design
